candidates.title: Predictive Multi-Tier Memory Management for KV Cache in Large-Scale GPU Inference
candidates.reason: This work explicitly manages KV state across GPU HBM, CPU DRAM, CXL memory, NVMe/GDS, RDMA and parallel filesystems with predictive movement, directly extending the survey's hierarchical-memory and storage-offload core lineage.

candidates.title: InKubeator: Pre-warming In-Memory KV Caches from Disk for Elastic LLM Serving
candidates.reason: InKubeator proactively pre-warms newly scaled serving instances from disk-backed KV state to remove cold-start prefill latency, directly connecting disk storage, KV movement and elastic serving.

candidates.title: Leyline: KV Cache Directives for Agentic Inference
candidates.reason: Leyline exposes explicit cache-control directives for mutable agent trajectories where append-only chatbot assumptions fail, directly updating agentic serving and KV lifecycle-management lineages.

candidates.title: Lodestar: An Online-Learning LLM Inference Router
candidates.reason: Lodestar learns online request routing under batching, KV reuse and heterogeneous accelerators, directly extending distributed serving and cache-aware scheduling lineages.

candidates.title: Native LLM and MLLM Inference at Scale on Apple Silicon
candidates.reason: vllm-mlx adds native Apple-Silicon continuous batching and multimodal prefix/cache optimizations, providing a current inference-engine design point outside CUDA-centric serving stacks.
